title.zh: 被關掉的不是定位，是時間：GNSS 干擾之所以每天都在開火，因為有一方已經把自己從那條共用訊號上拔下來了
title.en: What gets denied is time, not position: GNSS jamming fires every day because one side has already unplugged itself from the shared signal

focus.zh: GNSS 干擾擴散的原因不是干擾器變強，而是它同時滿足三個條件：便宜、法律上幾乎免費、而且不再對稱——中國的地基授時系統排定 2026 完工、長波覆蓋延伸至海岸外約 1,600 公里含整個海峽，俄軍在戰區內本來就不靠民用 GNSS。被關掉的那一方真正失去的不是導航（飛行員與船長有程序），而是被監管與工程同時綁死的「時間」：交易所的 100 µs、電信的次微秒同步、電網相角，以及你的日誌與 provenance graph 賴以排序的那個時鐘。西方的補丁最早 2028 才到，而且認證機制擋得住偽冒、擋不住干擾。
focus.en: GNSS denial is spreading not because jammers got better, but because it now satisfies three conditions at once: it is cheap, it is legally almost free, and it is no longer symmetric. China's ground-based high-precision timing system is scheduled to complete in 2026 and its long-wave coverage extends roughly 1,600 km offshore, covering the whole Strait; Russian forces inside the war zone never depended on civil GNSS in the first place. What the denied side actually loses is not navigation — pilots and masters have procedures for that — but time: the 100 microseconds regulators wrote into trading venues, sub-microsecond telecom sync, grid phase angle, and the clock your logs and provenance graphs are ordered by. The Western patch arrives 2028 at the earliest, and authentication stops spoofing, not jamming.

title.zh: 干擾不再是相互傷害：北京把自己從共用頻段上拔下來了，海峽在它的地面授時網覆蓋範圍內
title.en: Jamming is no longer mutual harm: Beijing has unplugged itself from the shared band, and the Strait sits inside its terrestrial timing coverage

summary.zh: 中國的「高精度地基授時系統」把空基（BDS）、光纖與陸基 eLoran 長波授時整合成一套不依賴衛星導航的授時骨幹，排定 2026 年完工；為達成全國覆蓋，另在敦煌、庫爾勒、那曲增建三座長波授時台。技術文獻指出，該系統以 BDS 共視法回溯至中國標準時間 UTC(NTSC)，但在衛星訊號不可用時可獨立運轉；差分技術可把授時精度從微秒級提升到 100 奈秒以內，兆瓦級長波發射的授時傳輸精度達 20 奈秒。安全分析（Breaking Defense，1/8，作者 Sean Gorman）進一步指出，中國的陸基 PNT 廣播網覆蓋延伸至海岸外約 1,000 英里（約 1,600 公里），涵蓋台灣海峽與所有接近航道；同一篇的判斷是，美方在台海情境下仍壓倒性依賴 GPS，而中國即使自身太空資產被癱瘓，其軍隊與經濟仍保有可用的 PNT 服務。另一條獨立線索指向同一個邏輯的另一面：中國分析人士公開把 BDS 民用頻段與 GPS 重疊描述為「有遠見的戰略規劃」——任何針對 BDS 民用訊號的干擾都會同時打到 GPS，這使得共用頻段本身成為一種嚇阻。
summary.en: China's High-precision Ground-based Timing System fuses space (BDS), fibre, and terrestrial eLoran long-wave timing into a timing backbone that does not depend on satellite navigation, and is scheduled to complete in 2026; three additional long-wave timing stations at Dunhuang, Korla and Nagqu were built to close national coverage. Technical literature describes traceability to China Standard Time UTC(NTSC) via BDS common-view, but independent operation when satellite signals are unavailable; differential techniques take timing accuracy from the microsecond level to under 100 nanoseconds, with megawatt-class long-wave transmission demonstrated at 20 ns. A security analysis (Breaking Defense, 1/8, by Sean Gorman) adds that China's terrestrial PNT broadcast network reaches roughly 1,000 miles (about 1,600 km) offshore, covering the Taiwan Strait and every approach; its argument is that the US remains overwhelmingly GPS-dependent in a Taiwan contingency, while China retains usable PNT for its military and economy even with its space assets degraded. A separate thread points at the same logic from the other side: Chinese analysts publicly describe the overlap of BDS civil bands with GPS as 'farsighted strategic planning' — any interference aimed at BDS civil signals also hits GPS, which makes the shared band itself a deterrent.

implication.zh: 這條讓一個既有判斷直接失效：「GNSS 干擾具有自我約束，因為干擾者也用同一套訊號」。這個假設過去支撐了很多樂觀推論——包括認為中國不會在海峽大規模壓制 GNSS，因為會打到自己的航運與物流。地基授時網一旦完工並覆蓋海峽，這個對稱性就只剩下一半：中國的民用經濟在授時這一層有非衛星備援，台灣與美方沒有。請注意這裡的分層很重要——BDS 民用頻段與 GPS 重疊確實讓「純定位」的相互傷害仍然成立，但授時可以完全走陸基長波與光纖，不經過那個被干擾的頻段。也就是說，對方保留的不是「干擾時仍能導航」，而是「干擾時時鐘不會漂」。對你評估台海情境，該問的問題從「解放軍會不會干擾 GNSS」換成「在 GNSS 全頻段不可用的第 72 小時，台灣的交易所、電信基站、電網相量與資料中心各自靠什麼守住時間」。
implication.en: This invalidates a standing judgment outright: that GNSS jamming is self-limiting because the jammer uses the same signals. That assumption underwrote a lot of optimism — including the view that China would not suppress GNSS across the Strait at scale because it would hit its own shipping and logistics. Once the ground timing network is complete and covers the Strait, only half of that symmetry survives: China's civil economy has a non-satellite fallback at the timing layer; Taiwan and the US do not. The layering matters — BDS civil bands overlapping GPS does keep mutual harm real for pure positioning, but timing can run entirely on terrestrial long-wave and fibre, never touching the jammed band. What the other side preserves is not 'we can still navigate while jamming', it is 'our clocks do not drift while jamming'. For a Taiwan contingency the question changes from 'will the PLA jam GNSS' to 'at hour 72 of an all-band GNSS outage, what holds time for Taiwan's exchange, base stations, grid phasors and data centres?'

counterpoint.zh: 最強的反駁是完工不等於可用：這套系統的完工時程來自中國自身的科研與行業報導，沒有第三方獨立驗證其覆蓋、可用率與抗打擊能力；長波授時台是體積大、位置固定、極易被鎖定的目標，在真正的高強度衝突中未必比衛星耐打。此外，把陸基授時整合進民用電信與金融系統需要終端側大規模換裝接收機——中國是否真的完成了這一步，公開資料無法證實。若終端普及率低，這套備援在承平期是政策資產，在戰時仍可能是紙上能力。
counterpoint.en: The strongest rebuttal is that completion is not availability. The schedule comes from Chinese research and trade reporting with no third-party verification of coverage, uptime, or survivability; long-wave timing stations are large, fixed and easy to target, and may not outlast satellites in a genuinely high-intensity fight. Integrating terrestrial timing into civil telecom and finance also requires a mass receiver refit at the edge, and open sources cannot confirm China has done that. With low edge adoption, the fallback is a peacetime policy asset and possibly still a paper capability in war.

title.zh: 時間是 provenance graph 上唯一沒被驗證過的那條邊：時鐘來源可偽造，跨主機的因果排序就繼承了一個未驗證輸入
title.en: Time is the one unverified edge in a provenance graph: if the clock source is forgeable, cross-host causal ordering inherits an unauthenticated input

summary.zh: The Aerospace Corporation 維護的太空系統攻擊技術目錄 SPARTA 把「Time Spoof」正式列為一項技術（編號 EX-0014.01），也就是攻擊者不改動資料本身、只操縱受害系統取得的時間基準。學術界對此的主流緩解方向不是加固 GNSS 接收機，而是引入「另一個時間來源」做交叉檢查：以網路授時（NTP）、Wi-Fi 信標的已驗證時戳、或專用授時基礎設施比對時鐘偏移，用不一致本身當偵測訊號。另一條路線是用時空一致性做廣域偵測——有研究以 AIS 船舶回報的時空相干性判別區域性干擾事件，指出跨多個獨立資料點的時空叢集，是把「真實的區域干擾」與「單一載具內部異常」分開的有效判準。數位鑑識這一側的既有實務則明確依賴時戳與雜湊（SHA-256／MD5）共同支撐證據能力，其中雜湊保證內容未被竄改，時戳保證順序——但雜湊有密碼學保證，時戳通常沒有。
summary.en: SPARTA, the space-system attack technique catalogue maintained by The Aerospace Corporation, lists 'Time Spoof' as a formal technique (EX-0014.01): the attacker does not touch the data, only the time base the victim system derives. The mainstream academic mitigation is not hardening the GNSS receiver but introducing a second time source for cross-checking — network time (NTP), authenticated Wi-Fi beacon timestamps, or dedicated timing infrastructure — and treating clock-offset inconsistency as the detection signal itself. A parallel line uses spatio-temporal coherence for wide-area detection: research using AIS vessel reports argues that clustering across many independent data points is what separates a genuine regional interference event from an anomaly confined to one platform. On the forensics side, established practice leans on timestamps and hashing (SHA-256/MD5) together for admissibility — the hash guarantees content integrity, the timestamp guarantees order. The hash has a cryptographic guarantee; the timestamp usually does not.

implication.zh: 對做威脅獵捕與 provenance graph 的人，這條的價值在於指出一個被普遍忽略的建模缺陷：圖上的節點與內容有完整性保護（雜湊、簽章、EDR 遙測鏈），但邊的方向——誰先誰後、誰導致誰——幾乎完全建立在各主機自報的時間上，而那個時間往往一路回溯到一顆可被關掉或被偽冒的衛星訊號。這在單一主機內問題不大（單調時鐘、開機計數可用），問題出在跨主機、跨組織的關聯：一次區域性授時偏移就足以讓不同來源的日誌在合併時產生錯誤的因果方向，而且不會產生任何告警——資料看起來完全正常，只是順序錯了。實務上值得做兩件事：一是把「時間來源」本身當成 provenance 的一級節點記錄下來（這台主機的時戳是從哪個 NTP／PTP 母鐘來的、母鐘當時是鎖定還是 holdover），二是在關聯引擎裡保留一個明確的「時間不確定度」欄位，讓跨來源排序在不確定度重疊時退化成無序，而不是硬給一個順序。這與本站 9/6報告談 MCP session 需要新增一類邊是同一種思路：把過去當成環境常數的東西，改成圖上可被質疑的一條邊。
implication.en: For anyone doing threat hunting or provenance graphs, this names a widely ignored modelling flaw: nodes and content on the graph have integrity protection (hashes, signatures, EDR telemetry chains), but edge direction — what came first, what caused what — rests almost entirely on each host's self-reported time, and that time usually traces back to a satellite signal that can be switched off or forged. Within one host this is manageable (monotonic clocks, boot counters). The problem is cross-host and cross-organisation correlation: one regional timing offset is enough to give merged logs the wrong causal direction, with no alert at all — the data looks perfectly normal, only the order is wrong. Two things are worth doing in practice. First, record the time source itself as a first-class provenance node: which NTP/PTP grandmaster this host's timestamps came from, and whether that grandmaster was locked or in holdover at the time. Second, carry an explicit time-uncertainty field through the correlation engine so that cross-source ordering degrades to 'unordered' when uncertainty intervals overlap, instead of asserting an order anyway. This is the same move as the 9/6報告 argument that MCP sessions need a new class of edge: take something previously treated as an environmental constant and make it a questionable edge on the graph.

title.zh: 波羅的海是這件事的實驗室：8 月前 19 天有 63% 的日子全頻段被壓制，而制度性代價目前接近零
title.en: The Baltic is the laboratory: all-band denial on 63% of days in the first 19 days of August, at an institutional cost of approximately zero

summary.zh: 波蘭國家電信研究所 8/26 公布的監測分析顯示，格但斯克監測站記錄到的 GNSS 蓄意干擾自 2026 年初起持續且劇烈上升，形態橫跨「數小時全頻譜中斷」與「僅限單一頻段的窄帶干擾」：5 月與 6 月約 70% 的日子出現跨所有 GNSS 頻段的長時間顯著干擾，完全無干擾的日子在 5 月僅佔 10%、6 月 13%；8 月前 19 天則有 63% 的日子出現全面性中斷。受影響的不只是航空與航運：民用 GPS 接收器、共享運具系統、市政車隊與商用無人機同時失能，波蘭獵雷艦 ORP Albatros 於 8/21 在波羅的海執行任務時遭遇 GPS 干擾。歸因方面，波蘭民航局已於 2025 年 7 月向 ICAO 表示干擾源自俄羅斯領土；Gdynia 海事大學與德國宇航中心（DLR）的研究以到達時間差（TDOA）定位法把源頭指向加里寧格勒的 Okunevo 天線陣與 Baltiysk 一帶，立陶宛則稱加里寧格勒的偽冒基礎設施已從 2025 年初的數具天線擴增至數十具。制度面上：ICAO 大會於 2025 年 10 月依 Estonia、Finland、Latvia、Lithuania、Poland、Sweden 六國提交的證據，認定源自俄羅斯與北韓的重複性 GNSS 射頻干擾違反 1944 年芝加哥公約；歐盟則對俄軍第 841 獨立電子戰中心成員（含兩名負責加里寧格勒方向的高階軍官）實施制裁。俄羅斯否認不當行為，且自 2022 年以來未能重返 ICAO 理事會席位；ICAO 呼籲後未見任何改正行動或接觸。
summary.en: Poland's National Institute of Telecommunications published monitoring analysis on 8/26 showing that deliberate GNSS interference recorded at its Gdańsk station has risen steadily and drastically since the start of 2026, in two shapes: multi-hour full-spectrum outages, and narrow disruption confined to a single band. In May and June, significant long-duration interference across all GNSS bands occurred on roughly 70% of days, with completely clean days at just 10% in May and 13% in June; in the first 19 days of August, full-scale disruption hit 63% of days. The effects go past aviation and shipping: civilian GPS receivers, shared-mobility systems, municipal fleets and commercial drones fail together, and the Polish minehunter ORP Albatros hit GPS jamming during a Baltic mission on 8/21. On attribution, Poland's Civil Aviation Authority told ICAO in July 2025 that the interference originates from Russian territory; researchers at Gdynia Maritime University and Germany's DLR used time-difference-of-arrival localisation to point at the Okunevo antenna complex in Kaliningrad and the Baltiysk area, while Lithuania says spoofing infrastructure in Kaliningrad grew from a few antennas in early 2025 to several dozen. Institutionally: in October 2025 the ICAO Assembly, on evidence submitted by Estonia, Finland, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland and Sweden, found that recurring GNSS radio-frequency interference originating from Russia and the DPRK breaches the 1944 Chicago Convention; the EU has sanctioned members of Russia's 841st Separate Electronic Warfare Centre, including two senior officers overseeing the Kaliningrad direction. Russia denies wrongdoing, has not regained its ICAO Council seat since 2022, and no corrective action or engagement has followed ICAO's calls.

implication.zh: 這一條的用處不在「俄羅斯又在干擾」，而在於它是目前唯一一個把「常態化 GNSS 阻斷」的完整代價曲線跑完的真實樣本，而結論是：代價幾乎為零。國際民航組織能做到的最強動作是認定違反公約——沒有強制力、沒有停權、沒有補償機制；歐盟能做到的最強動作是制裁兩名軍官與一個電子戰單位。這兩者加起來，對一個已被全面制裁、且已退出該理事會的國家而言，邊際成本趨近於零。對你評估台海的意義是直接的：如果一個持續 18 個月、影響六個 NATO 成員國民航與航運的干擾行為，最終只換來一份決議與兩個人名，那麼在台海預期「國際壓力會阻止長期 GNSS 壓制」就沒有經驗基礎。反過來說，這也給了台灣一個難得的免費樣本——波羅的海這一年半的資料，本質上是台灣可以拿來做壓力測試的公開資料集。
implication.en: The value here is not 'Russia is jamming again' but that this is the only real-world sample that has run the full cost curve of normalised GNSS denial to the end — and the answer is that the cost is close to zero. The strongest thing ICAO can do is find a Convention breach: no enforcement, no suspension, no compensation mechanism. The strongest thing the EU can do is sanction two officers and one EW unit. Against a state already comprehensively sanctioned and already off that Council, the combined marginal cost rounds to nothing. The read-across to Taiwan is direct: if eighteen months of interference affecting the civil aviation and shipping of six NATO members yields one resolution and two names, then expecting international pressure to deter sustained GNSS suppression in the Strait has no empirical basis. Read the other way, this hands Taiwan an unusually cheap gift — eighteen months of Baltic data is effectively a public stress-test dataset.

counterpoint.zh: 誠實的反面是：這 18 個月裡沒有因 GNSS 干擾導致的航班失事或船舶重大事故。航空與航運確實在退化中維持了安全——多頻多星座接收機、慣性導航、地面導航台（VOR／DME／ILS）與程序性緩解共同吸收了衝擊，EASA 與 IATA 也建立了聯合行動計畫。也就是說，「制度回應無效」與「系統實際上撐住了」可以同時為真；把常態化干擾直接等同於災難，會高估短期風險。真正沒被這 18 個月測到的，是授時側——波羅的海的干擾主要作用在移動載具的定位，尚未出現一次公開記錄的、導致區域性金融或電網授時失效的事件。我這篇的整個論證，本質上是在說「還沒被測到的那一側才是脆弱的」，而這在定義上還沒有實證。
counterpoint.en: The honest counter is that in eighteen months there has been no hull loss or major maritime casualty attributable to GNSS interference. Aviation and shipping have genuinely stayed safe while degraded — multi-frequency multi-constellation receivers, inertial navigation, ground aids (VOR/DME/ILS) and procedural mitigations absorbed it, and EASA and IATA have stood up a joint action plan. So 'the institutional response is ineffective' and 'the system actually held' can both be true, and equating normalised interference with catastrophe overstates near-term risk. What these eighteen months have not tested is the timing side: Baltic interference has mainly acted on the positioning of moving platforms, and there is no publicly documented case yet of a regional financial or grid timing failure. The whole argument of this piece is essentially that the untested side is the fragile one — which by definition is not yet demonstrated.

title.zh: 干擾正在從「拒止」升級為「轉向」：把對手的無人機推進第三國領空，而意圖從機外無法證明
title.en: Denial is becoming redirection: pushing an opponent's drones into a third country's airspace, with intent unprovable from outside

summary.zh: 立陶宛表示，俄羅斯正以 GPS 偽冒把烏克蘭的攻擊型無人機導離航線、推向 NATO 空域；此說法出現的數日後，一架俄方無人機擊中羅馬尼亞一棟公寓、造成兩名平民受傷，據報是 2022 年入侵以來 NATO 領土上的首批傷亡。相關報導指出，加里寧格勒的俄軍電子戰單位透過干擾與偽冒使烏克蘭無人機失去導航精度，飛向波羅的海三國與芬蘭方向；2026 年 3 月已出現烏克蘭無人機同時擊中三個波羅的海國家的事件，並引發「是否為俄方刻意重導」的公開爭論。俄方對波羅的海 GNSS 干擾的官方立場是：這是保護本國領土、混淆潛在烏克蘭無人機的正當防衛措施；波羅的海各國官員反駁的理由是，多起干擾事件發生的位置離俄羅斯邊境很遠。與此同時，Secure World Foundation 2026 年全球反太空能力報告指出，目前有 13 個國家在尋求某種攻擊對手衛星的能力，而在所有反太空手段中，電子戰與網路作戰是唯一在軍事行動中被實際持續使用的兩種。
summary.en: Lithuania says Russia is using GPS spoofing to steer Ukrainian strike drones off course and into NATO airspace; days after that claim, a Russian drone hit an apartment block in Romania and wounded two civilians — reportedly the first casualties on NATO soil since the 2022 invasion. Related reporting describes Russian EW units in Kaliningrad jamming and spoofing GPS so that Ukrainian drones lose navigation accuracy and drift toward the Baltic states and Finland; in March 2026 Ukrainian drones struck all three Baltic states, prompting open debate over whether Russia had deliberately redirected them. Russia's official position on Baltic GNSS interference is that it is a legitimate defensive measure to protect its territory and confuse potential Ukrainian drones; Baltic officials counter that many of the events occur far from the Russian border. Meanwhile the Secure World Foundation's 2026 global counterspace report finds 13 nations now pursuing some capability to attack adversary satellites — and that among all counterspace methods, electronic warfare and cyber operations are the only two actually used on a sustained basis in military operations.

implication.zh: 這條把 GNSS 干擾從「環境噪音」重新分類成「一種帶有目標選擇效果、但沒有歸屬證據的火力」。這裡的機制值得說清楚：偽冒讓攻擊方獲得一個既有效又免責的位置——如果一架烏克蘭無人機落在羅馬尼亞，物理上的發射者是烏克蘭，武器是烏克蘭的，落點是俄方選的，而「選」這個動作在機外完全不可觀測。對 NATO 而言這是一個結構性難題：Article 5 的門檻設計預設攻擊者可辨識，而這種手法的整個價值就在於把可辨識性移除。與本站 8/31週報 談自主終端導引時的結論其實是同一個形狀——那次是「人類選定目標」這條線從機外不可驗證，這次是「誰把它導到那裡」從機外不可驗證。SWF 那個數字則提供了尺度感：13 國在追求反太空能力，但真正每天在開火的只有電子戰這一種，因為只有它不留殘骸、不製造碎片、不觸發任何條約。
implication.en: This reclassifies GNSS interference from 'environmental noise' to 'a fire mission with target-selection effects and no attribution trail'. The mechanism is worth stating plainly: spoofing buys the attacker a position that is both effective and deniable — if a Ukrainian drone lands in Romania, the physical launcher is Ukrainian, the weapon is Ukrainian, the impact point was chosen by Russia, and the act of choosing is entirely unobservable from outside the airframe. For NATO this is structural: the Article 5 threshold assumes an identifiable attacker, and the whole value of this technique is removing identifiability. It is the same shape as the conclusion in 8/31週報 on autonomous terminal guidance — there, 'a human selected the target' was unverifiable from outside the airframe; here, 'who steered it there' is unverifiable from outside the airframe. The SWF number supplies the scale: 13 states pursue counterspace capability, but only one method is fired daily, because only electronic warfare leaves no wreckage, creates no debris, and triggers no treaty.

counterpoint.zh: 反方版本同樣自洽，而且我無法排除：俄方確實在自家領土上空大規模干擾以防禦烏克蘭無人機（這是它自己的說法，也是任何交戰方都會做的事），而烏克蘭無人機因此失去導航、隨機漂向鄰國——同一組物理現象，完全不需要「刻意重導」這個意圖。要在這兩種解釋之間做判別，需要的證據是干擾／偽冒的方向性與時序是否與特定無人機航跡相關，而這類資料掌握在少數幾個國家的訊號情報單位手上，不會公開。因此立陶宛的說法在證據等級上仍是政府主張，不是可獨立驗證的事實；我把它標為 likely 而非 confirmed，就是這個原因。任何人拿這條去跟外國對談時，都應該連同這個不確定性一起講——否則對方一句「那是烏克蘭自己的無人機」就把整個論點卸掉。
counterpoint.en: The opposing version is equally coherent and I cannot rule it out: Russia really is jamming heavily over its own territory to defend against Ukrainian drones (which is its stated position and what any belligerent would do), and Ukrainian drones consequently lose navigation and drift randomly into neighbours — the same physics, with no need for deliberate redirection as an intent. Discriminating between the two requires evidence on whether the directionality and timing of the jamming or spoofing correlates with specific drone tracks, and that data sits with a handful of national SIGINT agencies and will not be published. Lithuania's claim therefore remains a government assertion, not an independently verifiable fact — which is exactly why this is marked likely rather than confirmed. Anyone carrying this into a conversation with foreign counterparts should carry the uncertainty with it; otherwise a single 'those are Ukraine's own drones' dismantles the whole point.

items.source: 立陶宛政府說法，經 Defense News 與 Militarnyi 報導；Secure World Foundation《2026 全球反太空能力報告》

title.zh: 監管把交易場所綁在 100 微秒上，而那個微秒的源頭在天上：RTS 25 的可追溯性義務就是一條 GNSS 依賴
title.en: Regulation bolts trading venues to 100 microseconds, and that microsecond comes from orbit: the RTS 25 traceability duty is a GNSS dependency

summary.zh: 歐盟 MiFID II 下的技術標準 RTS 25（Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/574）第 1 條規定，交易場所營運者的業務時鐘必須以 UTC 為時間基準；容許的最大偏離採分級制，取決於交易系統的閘道對閘道延遲：延遲大於 1 毫秒者為 1 毫秒，延遲小於等於 1 毫秒者為 100 微秒。也就是說，語音交易櫃檯（1 秒）與高頻共置引擎（100 微秒）之間相差四個數量級，最嚴格的那一格正是高頻交易。實務上，UTC 可追溯時間的來源以 GNSS 為主，且必須明確處理 GNSS 對 UTC 的偏移（閏秒），不得預設為零；時間在機房內的傳遞則以 PTP（IEEE 1588）為主流方案。合規義務不止於精度：受規範實體必須建立一套對 UTC 的可追溯性系統，記錄其設計、運作與規格，明確指出時戳的施加點，並至少每年檢視一次合規性。相對照的是工程側的物理限制——銣原子鐘等級的母鐘在失去 GNSS 後 24 小時內漂移約 100 至 500 奈秒，一般 OCXO 則漂移 1 至 10 微秒；也就是說，配備銣鐘的機房可以在全頻段干擾下撐過一整天而仍在 100 微秒之內，只配 OCXO 的則在數小時內就可能觸及邊界。
summary.en: Under MiFID II, RTS 25 (Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/574) requires in Article 1 that business clocks of trading venue operators use UTC as their time reference. Maximum divergence is tiered by the trading system's gateway-to-gateway latency: 1 millisecond where latency exceeds 1 ms, and 100 microseconds where latency is at or below 1 ms. A voice trading desk (1 second) and an HFT co-location engine (100 microseconds) sit four orders of magnitude apart, and the tightest cell is exactly high-frequency trading. In practice UTC-traceable time comes mainly from GNSS, and the GNSS-to-UTC offset (leap seconds) must be explicitly handled rather than assumed to be zero; distribution inside the data centre is predominantly PTP (IEEE 1588). The obligation is not only accuracy: regulated entities must establish a system of traceability to UTC, document its design, functioning and specifications, identify the exact point at which a timestamp is applied, and review compliance at least annually. Set against that is the engineering limit: a rubidium-class grandmaster drifts roughly 100–500 nanoseconds in the 24 hours after losing GNSS, while a typical OCXO drifts 1–10 microseconds. A rubidium-equipped facility can ride out a full day of all-band jamming and stay inside 100 microseconds; an OCXO-only one can approach the boundary within hours.

implication.zh: 這條的價值在於它把一個地緣政治變數翻譯成一個你能自己算的數字。合規門檻（100 微秒）與 holdover 漂移率（銣鐘每日 100–500 奈秒、OCXO 每日 1–10 微秒）一除，就得到「這個機房能承受幾小時的 GNSS 中斷而不失去 UTC 可追溯性」——這是一個具體、可稽核、而且目前幾乎沒有人在做的韌性指標。順帶注意 RTS 25 的義務結構本身：它要求的是可追溯性與文件化，並沒有規定備援來源，所以一個完全合規的交易場所可以是單一 GNSS 依賴。對台股投資人與台灣的市場基礎設施而言，這裡有一個具體且可查證的缺口值得問：台灣的交易與結算系統以什麼作為 UTC 可追溯來源、母鐘等級為何、是否有非 GNSS 的第二來源。已有分析指出台灣股市的高頻交易以 GPS 打時戳、在 GPS 被干擾期間將無法進行，而台灣政府對這項脆弱性的認知偏慢——這個說法我目前只看到單一分析來源，不宜當定論，但它正好是一個你能直接向主管機關求證的具體問題。
implication.en: The value here is that it converts a geopolitical variable into a number you can compute yourself. Divide the compliance threshold (100 microseconds) by the holdover drift rate (100–500 ns/day for rubidium, 1–10 µs/day for OCXO) and you get 'how many hours of GNSS outage this facility can absorb before losing UTC traceability' — a concrete, auditable resilience metric that almost nobody currently tracks. Note also the shape of the RTS 25 obligation: it mandates traceability and documentation, not a backup source, so a fully compliant venue can be a single-source GNSS dependency. For Taiwan-market investors and Taiwan's market infrastructure there is a specific, checkable gap worth raising: what does Taiwan's trading and settlement stack use as its UTC-traceable source, what grade is the grandmaster, and is there a non-GNSS second source? One analysis argues that Taiwanese HFT is GPS-timestamped and would not be possible during GPS jamming, and that the government has been slow to recognise the vulnerability — a single-source claim I would not treat as settled, but precisely the kind of question you can put to a regulator directly.

counterpoint.zh: 反面意見有分量：授時韌性其實比導航韌性容易解，而且解法便宜。一台銣鐘母鐘的成本以萬美元計，對任何一家交易所或大型券商而言不是預算問題；PTP 網路內的多母鐘冗餘、以及以光纖授時或 NTP 池做交叉檢查，都是成熟且不需要新政策的工程手段。換句話說，我這條把「監管門檻＋單一 GNSS 來源」描述成結構性風險，但它也可能只是一個尚未被優先處理的採購項目——一旦真的出事，市場會在一個季度內自己補上，不需要國家級的 eLoran。若這個反駁成立，那麼授時脆弱性的真正受害者不是金融業（有錢、集中、受監管），而是電信基站與電網變電所這類數量龐大、單點價值低、換裝週期以十年計的資產。
counterpoint.en: The rebuttal carries weight: timing resilience is actually easier to fix than navigation resilience, and the fix is cheap. A rubidium grandmaster costs tens of thousands of dollars — not a budget question for any exchange or large broker — and multi-grandmaster redundancy inside a PTP network, plus cross-checking against fibre timing or NTP pools, are mature engineering moves requiring no new policy. So while I frame 'regulatory threshold plus single GNSS source' as structural risk, it may simply be an unprioritised procurement item that the market would close within a quarter of a real incident, with no national eLoran required. If that rebuttal holds, the real victims of timing fragility are not finance (rich, concentrated, regulated) but telecom base stations and grid substations: numerous, individually low-value, and on ten-year refresh cycles.

items.source: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/574（MiFID II RTS 25）條文；產業授時工程文獻對 holdover 漂移率的量測

title.zh: 補丁最早 2028 才到，而且方向不對：OSNMA 擋得住偽冒、擋不住干擾，多頻多星座只是把被騙的時間延後四分鐘
title.en: The patch lands 2028 at the earliest and points the wrong way: OSNMA stops spoofing, not jamming, and multi-band receivers only delay spoof acceptance by four minutes

summary.zh: 歐盟的 Galileo 開放服務導航訊息認證（OSNMA）於 2025 年 7 月 24 日宣告正式運作，讓使用者可驗證導航訊息確實來自 Galileo 且未遭竄改；但 EUSPA 自己的說明明確指出，該服務並不能阻止偽冒、也不提供對干擾的防護，其作用是讓系統辨識出未經認證的導航資料。2026 年初的重點已從技術推出轉向終端採用——認證只有在接收機端實作後才生效，OSNMA 也才剛被納入民航接收機標準，是民航採用的第一步。地面備援方面：英國正在建置國家自有的 eLoran 系統，初始作戰能力訂在 2028 年初、完全作戰能力 2030 年；美國至今尚未建成 eLoran（2008 與 2015 兩度宣示意向），交通部今年 1 月的動作是把合約發給 11 家公司做「示範」，其中 Hellen Systems、UrsaNav 與 Serco 三家做 eLoran——示範不是部署。低軌方案上，Xona Space Systems 已發射首顆量產級 LEO PNT 衛星，Pulsar 規劃最多 258 顆、宣稱訊號強度可達傳統 GPS 的 100 倍並沿用既有 L 頻段硬體。至於接收機端的自救，2026 年的實驗評估顯示多頻多星座接收機顯著延後、但並未阻止對偽冒訊號的接受，延長情境下的延後幅度為 4 分鐘以上。
summary.en: The EU's Galileo Open Service Navigation Message Authentication (OSNMA) was declared operational on 24 July 2025, letting users verify that navigation information genuinely comes from Galileo and has not been tampered with. EUSPA's own description is explicit that the service does not prevent spoofing and offers no protection against jamming; what it does is let systems identify unauthenticated navigation data. By early 2026 the focus had shifted from technical rollout to operational adoption — authentication only takes effect once implemented at receiver level, and OSNMA has only just entered civil aviation receiver standards, the first step toward aviation adoption. On terrestrial backup: the UK is building a nationally owned eLoran system with initial operating capability at the start of 2028 and full operating capability in 2030. The US still has no eLoran (intent announced in 2008 and again in 2015); the Department of Transportation's move in January was to award contracts to 11 companies to demonstrate GPS-backup technologies, three of them — Hellen Systems, UrsaNav and Serco — on eLoran. A demonstration is not a deployment. In low orbit, Xona Space Systems has launched its first production-class LEO PNT satellite, with Pulsar planned at up to 258 satellites, claiming signal strength up to 100x legacy GPS while reusing existing L-band hardware. As for receiver-side self-help, 2026 experimental evaluation shows multi-band multi-constellation receivers significantly delay — but do not prevent — acceptance of spoofed signals, with the delay exceeding four minutes in extended scenarios.

implication.zh: 把這些時程排在一起，會看到一個經常被混淆的錯配：現在幾乎所有的公開投資與政策注意力都放在「認證」與「多星座」，也就是對抗偽冒；但波羅的海每天實際發生的是干擾（拒止），而認證對拒止完全無效——訊號被壓到雜訊底下時，沒有東西可以驗證。這個錯配的成因不難理解：偽冒有戲劇性、可以做出漂亮的示範，而干擾只是把訊號淹掉。實務上的判準因此很簡單：任何供應商向你推銷 GNSS 韌性方案時，先問它解的是拒止還是偽冒；若答案是後者，它解的不是你在波羅的海或海峽會遇到的那個問題。同時，2028 到 2030 這個時間窗有一個直接的推論——在西方地面備援就位之前的這三到四年，是干擾行為的成本效益最高的一段時期，理性的對手會在這個窗口內把常態化壓制推到最大，而不是等你補完。
implication.en: Line these timelines up and a frequently missed mismatch appears: almost all public investment and policy attention goes to authentication and multi-constellation — that is, to countering spoofing — while what actually happens daily in the Baltic is jamming, denial, against which authentication does nothing. When the signal is buried under the noise floor there is nothing left to authenticate. The cause is not mysterious: spoofing is dramatic and demos well; jamming just drowns the signal. The practical test is therefore simple: when a vendor pitches you GNSS resilience, ask first whether it addresses denial or spoofing; if the answer is spoofing, it does not solve the problem you will meet in the Baltic or the Strait. There is also a direct inference from the 2028–2030 window: the three to four years before Western terrestrial backup exists is the period of maximum cost-effectiveness for interference, and a rational adversary pushes normalised suppression to its maximum inside that window rather than waiting for you to finish patching.

counterpoint.zh: 有兩個理由認為我把這個缺口講得太悲觀。其一，低軌方案可能比政府時程快得多：LEO 衛星距地面遠近於 GPS 的 20,200 公里，訊號到達強度可高出約 1,000 倍，本身就大幅提高抗干擾門檻；Xona 沿用既有 L 頻段硬體代表終端不需大改，而 Iridium 一類的商用授時服務已經在市場上。商業部署不受 2028／2030 這種國家計畫時程約束。其二，「認證無用論」有點過頭：OSNMA 確實不擋干擾，但它把攻擊者從「便宜的偽冒」逼回「昂貴且高調的壓制」，而壓制是可被偵測、可被定位（如 TDOA）、可被歸因的——換言之認證不是防護，是一種把對手推向留下證據的手段。這個效果在法律與外交層面的價值，可能比在工程層面大。
counterpoint.en: Two reasons to think I am overstating the gap. First, the low-orbit answer may arrive far ahead of government timelines: LEO satellites sit far closer than GPS's 20,200 km and their signals arrive up to a thousand times stronger, which raises the anti-jam threshold by itself; Xona's reuse of existing L-band hardware means the edge needs no major refit, and commercial timing services in the Iridium class are already on the market. Commercial deployment is not bound by 2028/2030 national programme schedules. Second, 'authentication is useless' overshoots: OSNMA does not stop jamming, but it pushes the attacker from cheap spoofing back to expensive, conspicuous suppression — and suppression is detectable, geolocatable (via TDOA) and attributable. Authentication is not protection; it is a way of forcing the adversary to leave evidence. That effect may be worth more in law and diplomacy than in engineering.

items.source: EUSPA 官方公告（Galileo OSNMA 服務運作滿一週年）；英國政府 eLoran 招標公告；美國交通部 GPS 備援示範合約；Sensors 期刊 2026 年接收機偽冒實驗評估

narrative.zh:
**上期推演校準**

8/31週報留了四條指標。第三條站得住，且比當時更明確：五角大廈把 5 億美元投給 Perennial Autonomy 的攔截無人機，網捕式攔截因不需頻譜許可、不發射彈藥被產業描述為「預設勝出」——反無人機採購確實在離開 RF 干擾器。第二條方向對但不可驗證：只查得到「2026 年 3 月後出廠機型已內建終端導引」，沒有百分比；這是我指標設計的錯，把不可驗證的東西寫成了可驗證指標。第一條（殘骸模組是否仍可讀）無新樣本，未定。

第四條被推翻，錯在我挑錯瓶頸。我當時要大家看「台灣那筆錢買到什麼」，預設卡點在採購與技術；實際是行政院 9/3 用追加預算繞過修法，然後在野兩黨把「先公告在野版無人機條例」變成 6,076 億元追加預算的通關條件（9/4報告、9/6報告）。錢卡在立法院，不在中科院——我把立法問題誤判成工程問題。CCW 第七次審查會議 11/16-20 才開，仍未定。再補一句對自己不利的：上期拿 Sky Fortress 當自我反駁，這三個月的新資料是往反駁那一邊加分。

**問題是什麼**

GNSS 干擾一直被寫成航空安全新聞，隱含假設是被攻擊的是「定位」。但定位是 GNSS 三項服務裡最容易替代的一項：飛行員有 VOR／DME／ILS 與慣性導航，船長有雷達與紙圖，這些程序在波羅的海被連續測試 18 個月，沒掉過一架飛機。沒有替代品、也沒有程序可退守的是時間——它危險不是因為精密，是因為被寫進法律與工程規格之後，所有人都忘了源頭在天上。

**機制怎麼運作**

三個條件同時成立才會變成每天的常態。便宜：13 國在追求反太空能力，但只有電子戰與網路作戰真的被持續使用，因為只有它們不留殘骸、不製造碎片、不觸發條約。法律上幾乎免費：波羅的海跑完了完整的代價曲線，18 個月、六國提交證據，換到的最強回應是一份 ICAO 認定與兩個被制裁的軍官名字。

第三個條件才是重點：不對稱。過去大家假設干擾具有自我約束，因為干擾者也用同一套訊號——中國技術社群把 BDS 民用頻段與 GPS 重疊講成「有遠見的戰略規劃」，正是這個邏輯。但這個對稱只在定位層成立。授時可以完全不經過被干擾的頻段：中國的地基授時系統把 BDS、光纖與陸基 eLoran 長波整合成不依賴衛星的骨幹，排定 2026 完工，覆蓋延伸至海岸外約 1,600 公里、涵蓋整個海峽。對方保留的不是「被干擾時仍能導航」，是「被干擾時時鐘不會漂」。

被關掉的那一方，時鐘會漂到哪裡去？把合規門檻除以 holdover 漂移率，就得到「這個機房能撐幾小時」——一個你能自己算、卻幾乎沒人在稽核的韌性指標。

**證據**

波蘭國家電信研究所 8/26 的監測分析把常態化的程度講死了：格但斯克站在 5、6 月約七成的日子全頻段被長時間干擾，8 月前 19 天有 63% 全面中斷。真正關鍵的是形態——它橫跨數小時全頻譜中斷與單一頻段窄帶干擾，後者代表這是可調控的選擇性操作，不是無差別噪音。歸因也跑得比政策快：Gdynia 海事大學與 DLR 用 TDOA 指向加里寧格勒的 Okunevo 天線陣。

**各方自己怎麼說**

俄羅斯的立場在自己框架內自洽：干擾是保護領土、混淆潛在烏克蘭無人機的正當防衛。莫斯科最尖銳的一點是，交戰國在自己領空做電子防護是任何人都會做的事，稱之為對第三國的攻擊，等於要求被攻擊方放棄防禦。波羅的海各國的反駁很精準：多起事件離俄羅斯邊境很遠，防禦說解釋不了覆蓋範圍。

歐盟與 ICAO 走規範路線，且清楚知道手上沒有工具。布魯塞爾最尖銳的一點是：把行為綁定到具體單位與人名，是為了讓未來追訴與資產凍結有法律基礎——這是建立記錄，不是期待嚇阻。它最不願承認的是俄羅斯自 2022 年就沒有 ICAO 理事會席位，這套機制對它幾乎沒有槓桿。

中國不對境外干擾做官方歸因，卻在技術社群公開把共用頻段講成嚇阻。北京最尖銳的一點是，這讓它同時主張兩件不矛盾的事：我們是共用頻段的受害者候選人，所以我們有權建自己的地面備援。它最不願被追問的是：既然共用頻段就是嚇阻，為什麼還需要一套覆蓋海峽的陸基授時網。台灣則同時暴露在定位與授時兩層，公開資料看不到國家級的非 GNSS 授時備援；台北的難處是資源排序——在飛彈、無人機與潛艦之間，授時韌性的政治可見度接近零，儘管單位成本以萬美元計。

**未來 3–6 個月的推演與觀察指標**

主判斷：西方地面備援就位前的 2026 至 2029，是常態化干擾成本效益最高的窗口，理性對手會在窗口內把壓制推到最大，而不是等你補完（英國 eLoran 初始作戰能力 2028 年初、2030 完全作戰；美國今年 1 月只發出示範合約）。四個可證偽指標：一、波蘭監測站的全頻段中斷日佔比是否越過 70% 並在冬季維持——回落到 40% 以下，我的窗口論就錯了。二、是否出現第一起公開記錄的授時側事故（交易場所、電信同步或電網相角），而非又一起導航側事故；這是我最缺的實證。三、有沒有受 RTS 25 規範的交易場所公開揭露非 GNSS 授時備援——那會直接推翻我把它當結構性風險。四、Xona Pulsar 商用授時是否在 2027 年前進入實際採購。CCW 11/16-20 維持上期判斷：最可能再延一次討論性授權。

**我可能錯在哪**

最可能錯的是把授時當成需要國家介入的結構性問題，而它其實只是尚未被優先處理的採購項目。反駁很有力：PTP 多母鐘冗餘、光纖授時與 NTP 交叉檢查都是成熟工程，不需要新政策，成本對任何交易所都不是問題；真出事，市場可能一個季度內自己補完。若這成立，我的分層要整個換掉：脆弱的不是金融業（有錢、集中、受監管），而是電信基站與電網變電所這種數量龐大、單點價值低、換裝週期十年的資產。

第二個可能的錯在中國那一側：我把「排定 2026 完工」當成能力已經成立來推論，但完工不等於可用。時程來自中國自身報導、無第三方驗證；長波台體積大、位置固定、極易被鎖定；陸基授時要進入民用電信與金融還需大規模換裝接收機，這一步證實不了。若終端普及率低，核心論證就從「不對稱已經發生」降級成「不對稱正在被建構」。
narrative.en:
**Calibrating the last forecast**

8/31週報 left four indicators. Item three holds, more firmly than when written: the Pentagon put $500M into Perennial Autonomy's interceptor drones, and industry describes net-capture interception as winning by default because it needs no spectrum permit and discharges no munition — counter-drone procurement really is moving off RF jammers. Item two is directionally right but unverifiable: all I can find is that airframes built after March 2026 ship with terminal guidance, with no percentage. That is my error in indicator design. Item one (whether modules in wreckage stay readable) has no new sample and stays open.

Item four is overturned, and I picked the wrong bottleneck. I told readers to watch what Taiwan's money buys, assuming the constraint was procurement and technology. Instead, on 9/3 the Executive Yuan routed around legislation with a supplemental budget, and the opposition then made prior publication of its own drone bill the price of admission for the NT$607.6bn supplemental (9/4報告, 9/6報告). The money is stuck in the legislature, not in the labs — I misread a legislative problem as an engineering one. CCW's seventh review conference does not convene until 11/16-20, so that stays open. And one note against myself: the Sky Fortress self-rebuttal in 8/31週報 has gained support, not lost it.

**What the problem actually is**

GNSS interference gets written as an aviation-safety story, which hides an assumption: that what is attacked is position. But position is the most substitutable of the three services GNSS provides. Pilots have VOR/DME/ILS and inertial navigation, masters have radar and paper charts, and those procedures have run for eighteen months in the Baltic without a hull lost. The thing with no substitute and no fallback procedure is time — dangerous not because it is precise, but because once it was written into law and engineering specifications, everyone forgot the source is in orbit.

**How the mechanism works**

Three conditions have to hold at once for this to become a daily norm. Cheap: 13 states pursue counterspace capability, but only electronic warfare and cyber are used on a sustained basis, because only they leave no wreckage, no debris, and trigger no treaty. Legally almost free: the Baltic has run the full cost curve — eighteen months, evidence from six NATO members, and the strongest response available was one ICAO finding and two sanctioned officers' names. Against a state already sanctioned and off that Council, the marginal cost rounds to zero.

The third condition is the point: asymmetry. The standing assumption was that jamming is self-limiting because the jammer uses the same signals — Chinese commentary frames the BDS/GPS civil-band overlap as farsighted strategic planning, exactly that logic. But the symmetry holds only at the positioning layer. Timing need never touch the jammed band. China's ground-based timing system fuses BDS, fibre and terrestrial eLoran long-wave into a backbone independent of satellite navigation, scheduled to complete in 2026, reaching roughly 1,600 km offshore and covering the whole Strait. What the other side keeps is not 'we can still navigate under jamming' but 'our clocks do not drift under jamming'.

So where does the denied side's clock drift to? Divide the compliance threshold by the holdover drift rate and you get how many hours the facility survives — a resilience number you can compute yourself and that almost nobody audits.

**The evidence**

Poland's National Institute of Telecommunications settled how normalised this is in its 8/26 analysis: its Gdańsk station saw long-duration all-band interference on roughly 70% of days in May and June, and 63% of the first 19 days of August were fully disrupted. What matters most is the shape — it ranges from multi-hour full-spectrum outages to narrow single-band disruption, and that second shape means a controllable instrument, not indiscriminate noise. Attribution has also run ahead of policy: Gdynia Maritime University and Germany's DLR used TDOA to point at the Okunevo antenna complex in Kaliningrad.

**How each side tells it**

Russia's position is coherent inside its own frame: interference is legitimate defence of its territory against Ukrainian drones. Moscow's sharpest point is that electronic self-protection over one's own airspace is what any belligerent does, and calling it an attack on third countries amounts to demanding the attacked party stop defending itself. The Baltic states' rebuttal is precise: many events occur far from the Russian border, and the defensive story does not explain the footprint.

The EU and ICAO run a normative line and know they hold no tools. Brussels' sharpest point is that binding conduct to a named unit and named individuals builds the legal basis for future prosecution and asset freezes: record-building, not expected deterrence. What it least wants to concede is that Russia has had no ICAO Council seat since 2022, so the mechanism has almost no leverage.

China makes no official attribution of interference abroad while its technical community openly frames the shared civil band as deterrence. Beijing's sharpest point is that this lets it hold two non-contradictory positions at once: we are a candidate victim of the shared band, therefore we are entitled to our own terrestrial fallback. What it least wants to be asked is why, if the shared band is deterrence, it also needs a ground timing network covering the Strait. Taiwan, meanwhile, is exposed at both layers with no national non-GNSS timing fallback visible in open sources; Taipei's difficulty is resource ordering — against missiles, drones and submarines, timing resilience has near-zero political visibility, even though it is priced per unit in the tens of thousands.

**Forecast and indicators, 3–6 months**

Main judgment: 2026 through 2029, before Western terrestrial backup exists, is the window of maximum cost-effectiveness for normalised interference, and a rational adversary maximises suppression inside it rather than waiting for you to patch (UK eLoran reaches initial capability in early 2028 and full capability in 2030; the US in January only issued demonstration contracts). Four falsifiable indicators. One: whether the Polish station's share of all-band outage days crosses 70% and holds through winter — below 40% and my window argument is wrong. Two: whether the first publicly documented timing-side incident appears (a trading venue, telecom sync, or grid phase angle) rather than another navigation-side one; this is the empirical gap in the argument. Three: whether any RTS 25-regulated venue discloses a non-GNSS timing fallback, which would directly refute treating this as structural risk. Four: whether Xona Pulsar's commercial timing service enters real procurement before 2027. On CCW 11/16-20 I keep last week's call: most likely another extension of a discussion mandate.

**Where I am most likely wrong**

The likeliest error is treating timing as a structural problem needing state intervention when it is merely an unprioritised procurement item. The rebuttal is strong: multi-grandmaster PTP redundancy, fibre timing and NTP cross-checking are mature engineering needing no new policy, at a cost no exchange would notice, so the market might close the gap within a quarter of a real incident and never need a national eLoran. If that holds, my layering is wrong: the fragile sector is not finance (rich, concentrated, regulated) but telecom base stations and grid substations — numerous, individually low-value, on ten-year refresh cycles.

The second possible error is on the China side: I reason from 'scheduled to complete in 2026' as if the capability already exists, but completion is not availability. The schedule comes from Chinese reporting with no third-party verification; long-wave stations are large, fixed and easy to target; and putting terrestrial timing into civil telecom and finance still requires a mass receiver refit nobody can confirm. If edge penetration is low, the core claim downgrades from 'the asymmetry has happened' to 'the asymmetry is being built'.
